findings.current: The hero was a man of many talents.
findings.defect: Calls the hero a man, although the source later explicitly says he was not human.
findings.rationale: The Korean describes his talents without identifying him as human.

findings.current: After changing trains at several Warp Gates and traveling thousands of kilometers, he had made it here.
findings.defect: Introduces trains where the source says he transferred between Warp Gates.
findings.rationale: 갈아타며 describes switching gates, not boarding trains.
findings.replacement: After traveling thousands of kilometers by way of several Warp Gates, he had made it here.
findings.source: 몇 번의 워프 게이트를 갈아타며 수천 킬로미터를 이동한 끝에 이곳까지 오게 되었다.

findings.current: *In the end, all you can change is the appearance.*
findings.defect: Turns a limit on what can be faked into a limit on what can be changed, weakening the contrast with his real power in the land ahead.
findings.rationale: 꾸며 낼 conveys fabrication; 겉모습 is outward appearance.
findings.replacement: *In the end, only appearances can be faked.*
findings.source: 꾸며 낼 수 있는 건, 결국 겉모습뿐이니까.

findings.current: the Skeleton King stepped forward, setting his jaw.
findings.defect: Adds a jaw-setting gesture and loses the emphasis on the force of his step.
findings.rationale: The source describes only his deliberate, forceful step.
findings.replacement: the Skeleton King took a firm step forward.

findings.current: Unless his curiosity was fully satisfied, it never stopped.
findings.defect: Loses Morgoth’s exacting standard: only the highest level would satisfy his curiosity.
findings.rationale: 최고의 수준 specifies a standard of excellence, not merely complete satisfaction.
findings.replacement: Nothing short of the very best could satisfy his curiosity.
findings.source: 최고의 수준을 충족하지 않는 한, 그의 호기심은 멈출 줄을 몰랐다.

findings.current: Unlike the others, he had never pledged his loyalty to Demon King Asmodeus, nor had he intended to give his life for him.
findings.defect: Changes lack of loyal service into lack of a formal pledge.
findings.rationale: 충성을 다 하지도 concerns loyalty in conduct; the source says nothing about whether he made a pledge.
findings.replacement: Unlike the others, he was not devoted to serving Demon King Asmodeus, nor did he intend to give his life for him.
findings.source: 자신은 다른 이들과 달리 마왕 아스모데우스에게 충성을 다 하지도, 그를 위해 목숨을 바칠 생각도 없었으니까.

summary: The draft preserves the chapter’s main sequence, but changes the hero’s identity, the disguise’s limits, and Morgoth’s relationship to Asmodeus.
